text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, thank you so much. I'll be sure to 
treasure this baking set~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
With this set, I can make all kinds of 
sweets! I'll be able to share plenty with 
everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You gave me homemade sweets once before, 
didn't you? That gave me so much courage 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too! That's actually the reason I chose 
to give you this present...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thank you very much~. If I was 
able to be a pillar of support for you 
two, that makes me so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Slumps and injuries are really painful. 
That's why I was hoping sweet treats might 
soothe those bitter feelings, you know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a tiny bit, I'd be happy 
if I could be the spark for it♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Um, would it be alright if I helped 
out too?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I want to help support 
those wonderful feelings!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, to hear you say such kind 
things! You're both such good, wonderful 
girls, I'm so happy~.
